case_goal: Verify that a user can export a booking entry from the system.
summary: The test logs in as admin, navigates to the day view, selects an existing entry, and initiates an export action.

steps.expected_result: Login page is displayed with username and password fields.
Admin is logged in and navigation bar appears with links to Report, Import, Rooms, Users, and a user button.

steps.target: User button to go to day view (xpath=/html/body/header/nav/nav[2]/form/input[6])
steps.expected_result: Page navigates to index.php with day view for area 2 and date 2026-05-03.

steps.target: First entry link in day view (xpath=//*[@id="day_main"]/tbody/tr[1]/td/div/a)
steps.expected_result: Entry details page is displayed at view_entry.php for the selected entry (id=2).
Export action is triggered (likely download of entry data).
